title: EV fleet charging – costs and status per vehicle | VOOL
description: Charge company cars and fleets without upgrading the grid connection. Real-time overview and costs per vehicle.

sections.title: Electrify the fleet without rebuilding the depot
sections.lead: Hardware and software built by one team. Charge five vehicles or thousands, and see the cost of each one.

items.title: Status of every vehicle
items.text: Charging, plugged in or on the road, with mileage and location, in real time.

items.title: Costs you can report
items.text: Energy and cost in kWh and euros per vehicle or for the whole fleet, for any period.

items.title: Cheaper energy
items.text: Vehicles charge when electricity prices are lowest, or at the times you set.

items.title: Any charger
items.text: The platform supports any OCPP 1.6 or 2.0 charger, so existing chargers can stay.

items.title: No grid upgrade
items.text: Load management shares the available power between vehicles.

items.title: Omniva: 300 chargers for its courier fleet
items.text: Over five years VOOL supplies Omniva with 300 chargers across Estonia.

items.title: Hansabuss charges electric buses at its existing hubs
items.text: The bus operator uses VOOL chargers at its Latvian hubs and at drivers’ homes, without major changes to the infrastructure.

sections.title: Tell us about your fleet
sections.lead: Number of vehicles, where they park and your grid connection. We will propose a setup.
